title: Exchange Online baseline risk acceptance
description: GATE-002. The artifact that lets a named control fail without failing the go-live gate. Every field is demanded because an exception missing any one of them cannot be reviewed, re-approved, bounded or retired, and an exception nobody can retire is a permanent hole with an approval attached.

anyOf.description: Bound to one resolved configuration by its canonical hash.
Bound by an explicitly stated, finite applicability instead.

SchemaVersion.description: DES-004. The exception contract is versioned independently of the baseline.

ControlId.description: The one catalog control this exception excuses. An exception that names no control excuses every control.

TenantId.description: The tenant directory identifier. Named by identifier rather than by domain, because a domain can be renamed out from under the exception.

ConfigurationHash.description: The canonical SHA-256 hash of the resolved configuration this exception was raised against, with or without the algorithm prefix the evidence envelope carries.

AppliesTo.description: The alternative to a configuration hash. An exception that is not pinned to one configuration must say exactly what it is pinned to instead, and that boundary must be finite.

BoundedBy.description: The named conditions that hold this exception open. An empty list is the word bounded without the fact.

Owner.description: The identity accountable for retiring this exception.

Justification.description: The business reason the control cannot be met. Held to a substantive length, because a one-word justification is a justification nobody can review.

CompensatingControl.description: What is carrying the risk in the meantime. Accepting a risk with nothing compensating for it is a gap, not an exception.

ExternalReference.description: The change or risk record outside this repository that this exception is filed under.

ApprovalIdentity.description: The approver. Held apart from the operator requesting the change at evaluation time, because a self-approved exception is an unapproved one.

ApprovalAuthority.description: DES-005 names exactly one role that may accept this risk. A schema admitting any other role makes the role advisory.

EffectiveTimeUtc.description: When the exception starts being honoured.

ExpiryTimeUtc.description: When the exception stops being honoured. An expiry nobody can compare against a clock is an exception that never expires.

Signature.description: DES-005 selected detached CMS. The signature binds the approval to the artifact bytes without mutating them.
